meta.title: Fastate AI — Fast Real Estate Sites, Built by AI
meta.description: Fast real estate sites, built by AI: describe your business and Fastate AI creates a tailored website for your brand in seconds.

hero.badge: A smarter website for real estate agents
hero.headline: Fast Real Estate Sites,
hero.intro: Tell us about your expertise and style in a few sentences—without browsing through preset templates. Fastate AI creates the design, copy, and portfolio experience for you.
hero.promptLabel: How would you describe your real estate business?
hero.examplePrompt: I am a friendly local real estate agent specializing in Kadıköy and Moda, helping clients find a home that truly fits their lifestyle.
hero.promptHelp: Just tell us about your style, market, and ideal clients.
hero.promptTooShort: Please describe your business using at least 10 characters.
hero.authNotice: You need an account before we create your site — you will continue right where you left off.

benefits.custom: A design tailored to your description

preview.body: Skip generic filters and discover homes through the lifestyle and feeling you are looking for.

steps.title: Turn your idea into a working website.
steps.oneBody: Explain your market, style, and audience in your own words.
steps.twoBody: AI selects the right structure and creates your copy and visual direction.
steps.threeBody: Manage listings, colors, and contact details from one dashboard.

value.title: A digital storefront that works for you every day.
value.intro: Fastate AI turns an agent's daily work into a more organized and polished experience.
value.siteTitle: A site that feels like you
value.siteBody: Every result begins with your business description; there is no preset template to choose.
value.listingBody: Present every property with a photo gallery, location, features, and contact form.
value.copyBody: Enter the essentials and get effective marketing copy you can edit in seconds.
value.portfolioBody: Add and edit listings, then see changes instantly on your live site.
value.leadBody: Visitors contact you from your listings while you manage every inquiry in one dashboard.

management.title: Your website, listings, and inquiries in one place.
management.body: Keep your portfolio current without dealing with technical details. Change colors, add listings, and follow incoming inquiries.
management.copyBody: Create an effective description from the room count, location, and highlights, then add your final touch.
management.sampleMessage: “Could we view the three-bedroom apartment in Caddebostan this weekend?”

personal.title: You do not pick a template; you tell us what you need.
personal.body: Fastate AI interprets your context to create a structure, tone, and content that suit your brand. The result feels made for you—not selected from a gallery.
personal.regionBody: Your service areas and local expertise take center stage.
personal.toneBody: Whether trusted, refined, friendly, or corporate, your voice carries into the design.
personal.contentBody: Headlines, colors, and presentation are created from the details you provide.
personal.contextBody: Your market, specialty, client profile, and brand tone are considered together.
personal.controlBody: Edit the generated site directly from your dashboard and publish whenever you are ready.

cta.title: Create your digital storefront today.
cta.body: Describe your business in a few sentences and we will shape the rest together.

faq.title: What you may want to know before starting.
faq.q1: Do I need an account to create a site?
faq.a1: Yes. Your business description stays in your browser and generation resumes automatically after login or signup.
faq.q2: Can I change the design later?
faq.a2: Yes. Update colors, fonts, and site copy from your dashboard whenever you like.
faq.a3: Use the dashboard listing form to add photos, price, rooms, location, and other details.
faq.a4: All inquiries from site and listing forms appear in the Inquiries area of your dashboard.

footer.tagline: Personal, manageable, AI-powered websites for real estate agents.
footer.market: Designed for real estate professionals in Turkey.
